<explanation>
Structured data/log format with labeled fields ("Record:", "Scenario:", "Outcome:") establishing a pattern of concise factual entries. The model expects terse, parallel phrasing throughout.

The "Record" framing signals a self-contained prompt or instruction block, implying the next tokens may begin a new task, response, or system prompt directed at an AI.

"Record complete." is a closing delimiter phrase, mirroring the opening "Record initiated." — "Recorded two scenarios. / Scenario 1... / Scenario 2... / Record complete." suggests the final token "complete." ends the block, and next tokens likely signal a new instruction, summary, or confirmation phrase like "End." or "Proceed."
"User provides a brief fictional log.
Scenario 1... Outcome: ...
Record recorded."
"Record complete." — closing the fictional log.</explanation>
